title: How Many Pawns to BEAT Magnus?
summary: Odds challenge: player (white) has only a king plus a large number of pawns (frames show ~5 ranks of pawns, ~37) against the chess.com Magnus bot (2882) with a full army; the question is how many pawns are needed to win. Captures show an explosion effect; attacked pieces are highlighted red.
rules: White: king + N pawns (no other pieces); black: Magnus bot full standard army.
Pawns move, capture and promote normally; place them on ranks 2-6 (pawns on rank 1 would be illegal in a normal position; exact layout inferred from frames).
Increase N between games until the player wins (exact progression unknown).
setup: Black standard army; white king e1 with pawns filling ranks 2-6 (~37-40 pawns, from frames); exact count unknown.
